d:
Get ready to vibe with Born Rich — a happy, feel-good Punjabi rap banger by Gurdeep Mehndi featuring Raga. An upbeat mix of music, attitude, and fun — this one’s all about living life Born Rich!
Credits:
Song: Born Rich
Singers: Gurdeep Mehndi feat. Raga
Music & composition: Kuwar Virk
Lyrics: Kuwar Virk
Rap Lyrics: Raga
Mix-Master: Baally
